review_method: Read all 15 source records and separated software-license/provenance tooling from vehicle-license or test-data records; directly reviewed SPDX Tool, C4CorpusTools, WhichLicense, nix-init, and the license-detection test-data source.

candidates.description: Generate Nix packages from URLs with hash prefetching, dependency inference, license detection, and more
candidates.reason: Direct review confirms license detection is incidental to a Rust/Nix package generator and the project is MPL-2.0, outside the v0 OSS permit list; retain only as provenance workflow reference.

candidates.description: Java tools for CommonCrawl corpus processing, Creative Commons license detection, boilerplate removal, language detection, and near-duplicate removal
candidates.reason: Direct review confirms Apache-2.0 but the code is an old CommonCrawl/Java corpus pipeline, not a source-tree license scanner for harvested application blocks; its dataset and attribution boundary need separate review.
The record is vehicle-license-plate detection, not software-license provenance, and reports no license; it is out of scope and unlicensed.

candidates.description: Deep Learning for Vehicle License Detection
candidates.reason: The record is GPL-3.0 vehicle-license detection, not software-license scanning; per lane policy it is held and never promoted to client reuse.

candidates.description: SPDX license detection and management tool
candidates.reason: Direct review confirms Apache-2.0, current source, per-file SPDX detection, JSON/XML reports, and header inspection, but it is an Ada tool requiring GNAT/Alire; install/build and coverage for JavaScript dependencies/assets are unproven.

candidates.description: Clojure library for software license detection in the Maven ecosystem
candidates.reason: The record describes a Maven/Clojure ecosystem tool under MPL-2.0, outside the v0 permit list and not a complete source/dependency/asset scan for the target web blocks.

candidates.description: Vehicle and license plate detection using Tensorflow Object Detection API
candidates.reason: The record is an old vehicle-license project with no software license; it is unrelated to code provenance and cannot be reused.

candidates.description: Sample licenses to test license detection
candidates.reason: The record is test fixture data with no reusable application license; it may support scanner testing but is not a block or license gate by itself.

Direct review confirms Apache-2.0 but the repository is archived and its Rust detector incorporates ScanCode license data with CC-BY-4.0 attribution; freshness, attribution, and application-asset coverage are unresolved.

candidates.description: Car license detection and tracking, trained on an Iranian car license dataset
candidates.reason: The record is MIT vehicle-license detection, not software-license scanning; model/data provenance is outside this block-admission gate.

candidates.description: Set of license-related files to use as a test suite for license scanners
candidates.reason: The record is Other-licensed test data rather than a scanner or reusable block; it may be a fixture only after attribution and data rights are checked.

candidates.description: A mock repo to test Licensee's license detection of repos
candidates.reason: The record is an MIT mock repository for Licensee tests, not a production scanner or block; retain as a fixture reference only.
The record has no license or description and is named for vehicle license plates; capability and provenance are unverified and out of scope.
